description: Deriving the base version from version-control tags when no manifest exists. When there is no primary manifest file, the tool falls back to the project's existing semantic-version tags: it takes the highest such tag as the base and applies the recommended increment, creating a new tag at the result. If there are no semantic-version tags at all, the base defaults to 1.0.0. Input describes a release run with no manifest and a given tag/commit history; output reports the set of tags newly created by the run.
